newsitem.title: USA: CheckFree to service Chase bill processing.
newsitem.headline: CheckFree to service Chase bill processing.

text.p: CheckFree Corp said Tuesday it has a three-year agreement with Chase Manhattan Bank to provide bill payment processing for the bank.
CheckFree said the pact calls for it to provide remittance processing for Chase's online banking products via personal computers, the Internet, touch-tone telephone and personal digital assistants.
Terms of the agreement were not released.
CheckFree designs, develops and markets services for electronic payments and collections, including financial transactions on the Internet.
In October CheckFree announced that it won a five-year agreement to provide Wells Fargo Bank with bill payment processing.
CheckFree shares rose 7/16 to trade at 18-1/2 Tuesday afternoon.
